title: From Gin's Book. The Font and the Architect

blocks.p: After he wrote the hour down, Rei could not sleep, so he turned back through Gin's book to the chapter Gin had called the capstone. He had skipped it twice. It was the one where Gin admitted, in his careful field voice, what he did not know. Rei read it now with the crow's look still on his skin, because whatever had looked up at the bird lived under the thing these pages were about.

doc.title: Chapter 14. The Font. Three Layers
lines: CVD Research Reference. Capstone, Book Three. The part we can stand to look at. (G.U.)

Layer One. What is known. The Font is the generating source of veil energy. Every practitioner's aperture is a relationship to the Font, the specific channel through which Font energy becomes ability. When you use ability you are not generating something from inside yourself. You are accessing something that exists outside you and that is, in some sense, aware that you are accessing it.

The Font is not a location in the geographic sense. It has no coordinates. Practitioners who have approached it describe a direction rather than a place, a gradient that grows steeper as one moves toward it, until at sufficient proximity the gradient is the only thing they can perceive.
The Font is also not an entity. It does not communicate, move, feed or pursue. It generates and receives. It has done both continuously across all recorded history.
It sustains the membrane. The veil is not self-sustaining. If the Font stopped generating, the membrane would dissolve.

It receives what crosses. Souls on the Font return path dissolve into it. Demons resist it. Spirits drift toward it slowly unless anchored. It is both origin and terminus, and the receiving end of that loop is closed to observation.
Layer Two. What can be inferred. Below this line we are guessing. (G.U.)
Some form of awareness. Those who came near it describe its presence as attention, not indifference, across cultures that never spoke to each other. I lean toward awareness. I cannot prove it.
A maintenance dependency. The membrane fluctuates locally in ways the Font alone does not explain. The pattern suggests distributed structural points rather than one central source.
Direction matters. The old traditions speak of orientations and angles, not positions. The older language may be more accurate than ours.
The membrane is changing. Most of the century's thinning is environmental. A residual is not. I think the residual is real.

Layer Three. The edge I could not cross. There is an anomaly in the Phase III data that the official model does not fit. I have theories. They explain too much, so I do not trust them. If the answer exists, it lives with practitioners who never wrote anything down. I could not find which ones. The work continues for someone else.

doc.title: A yellow post-it, stuck crooked over the rank table
lines: A note on names. The Axis and the Font are the same centre, named twice.
The Axis is the being. The anchor at the centre of the veil, the thirteenth and central of the light-anchors, the one the oldest records call the Architect.
The Font is what pours from it. When a report says Font pull, it means the centre reaching for anyone whose stability has thinned far enough to feel the current.
Do not let a junior conflate them.

doc.title: The rank table, last row
lines: X. Axis. The one true balance point of the system. Was human. Is no longer. The Architect.
Not a rank. A state. The direction the scale points.
Gin, in pencil. It was a person once. The archive notes say so. I think about that more than I should.

blocks.p: Two pages on, pasted in with the edges gone soft from handling, was the classified sheet Gin had never been cleared to own.

blocks.cap: The Architect, weather over a whole district

doc.title: The Architect Phenomenon. Working Classification (Classified Research)
lines: Classification. Autonomous corrective mechanism. Not an entity. Not a practitioner. Not a government or faction operation.

Trigger conditions. High-power practitioners who suppress ability long-term without sanctioned outlet. Practitioners who accumulate psychic energy without the natural exchange the veil requires. Significant anomalies in local veil balance caused by unusual practitioner activity.

Mechanism. Unknown. Theorized as Font-originating corrective pressure, appearing as targeted entity attention, accelerated veil degradation in the individual, or a directed supernatural event. The correction is not punitive in intent. It is structural.
Outcome. Forced ability expression. Acute possession vulnerability. Disappearance of subject. Death. In some cases, the subject survives and is integrated into the veil system in a new capacity.
Protocol response. Architect-flagged individuals are classified Priority Watch.
Predictability. Low. Months to decades. The subject is typically aware, because the Architect's attention is perceptible to sensitive practitioners as a specific quality of being watched.

doc.title: Gin's comment beside it
lines: I have been aware of my status for approximately three years. It is not threatening the way an entity's attention is threatening. It is more like the feeling of a very large system becoming aware of a very small irregularity. Patient. Inevitable. Not personal.
I find this more frightening than something personal. Personal things can be negotiated with. This cannot.
If you are a suppressor reading this, you should know that the math eventually balances. Not as threat. As information. Plan accordingly. G.U.

blocks.p: Rei read the comment three times. Three years of being watched. Three years of Gin putting it down to the great patient system under the city. And for three years something else had been standing across the street. Gin had been right about the feeling and wrong about whose eyes they were. He had blamed the Architect, and the Architect had only been the excuse the demon wore.

On the facing page Gin had drawn ten small boxes in a row, ruled with care, and written Noise over them. Rei had seen the boxes before without understanding them. Gin had shaded three of them in pencil and then rubbed the shading out.

doc.title: Noise. Ten boxes, Gin's ruling
lines: Noise is the disturbance you make in the structure. Using ability makes it. Changing the local veil makes it. Killing an entity that was part of the local structure makes it. Preventing an event that was supposed to happen makes it.
0 to 5. Quiet. Over 5, the Architect's attention is active and the world starts answering what you do with corrections.
At 10, a major Correction Event. Then the track settles back to 5.
Passive sight. 0. Invisible to the structure.
One moderate use of ability. 1. Single sustained or major use. 2.
Clearing an ordinary entity. 1. Clearing one that was part of the local ecology. 3, and something of the same weight appears elsewhere in the city within a day.
Preventing what was supposed to happen. 2 to 4. The energy goes somewhere else, same size, often near someone you know.
Quiet symbol work. 0. Rushed symbol work. 2.
Sealing a thin spot. 4. Another place thins.
Every quiet scene takes one away. A full rest takes two.
The Architect does not punish. It corrects. It is a conservation law, not a judge.

blocks.p: Rei sat with the book open on his knees until the window went grey. Everything the Healer had done was quiet. Kindness was quiet. A month of mercy had hardly moved the boxes at all, and the structure had never once turned to look at it. Whatever he did now, he understood, would be loud.
